PDF An Image-Based Modelling Approach To GPU-based Unstructured Grid Volume ...
Abstract Unstructured grid volume rendering on the GPU is an ongoing research goal. The main difficulty is how to map the irregular data efficiently to the graphics hardware. Grid cells cannot be directly processed by the pipeline since polyhedral cells are not basic graphics primitives. Thus, approaches that render directly from the grid must try to overcome inherent computational bottlenecks ...
